scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "vite build --config vite.electron.config.ts --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.js && electron ."
scripts.android:build-web: npm run android:prepare && vite build --mode android
scripts.android:editor:build-web: npm run android:prepare && vite build --mode android-editor
scripts.android:add: npm run android:build-web && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run android:build-web && cap sync android
scripts.android:editor:sync: npm run android:editor:build-web && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:editor:apk: npm run android:editor:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win dir
